subcategory_text: Organizational risk tolerance is determined and clearly expressed.
informative_references: Aligned with NIST CSF 2.0 GV.RM-02 (risk tolerance defined)
implementation_examples: Determine and express the organisational risk tolerance for privacy (qualitative, semi-quantitative, or quantitative)
Communicate the risk tolerance to privacy-risk owners and align it with enterprise risk tolerance
Ensure tolerance levels guide the selection of risk responses (accept, mitigate, transfer, avoid)
assessment_objectives: Determine whether the organisation's privacy risk tolerance is determined and documented
Determine whether the tolerance is communicated to risk owners
Determine whether risk responses are aligned to the tolerance
Determine whether tolerance reflects the perspective of data subjects (impact tolerance)
